observations: A retail box for LED car headlight bulbs, wrapped in clear plastic.
The side of the box displays a list of bulb types: H15, D1/D3, D2/D4, 880/881, H11/H8/H9, 9005/HB3, 9006/HB4, 9012.
A white sticker with 'H7' is applied to the bottom of the box, indicating the specific bulb type inside.
The box features text claiming '+300% brightness' and '+100% range'.
Checkboxes for voltage (12V, 24V, 12-24V) and color temperature (3000K, 6000K) are printed on the side but not marked.
No brand name is visible on the shown side of the packaging.

risks.risk: The manufacturer brand and specific technical specs (wattage, lumens) are unknown, which determines if these are premium or budget bulbs.
risks.proof: Photo of the front of the box showing the brand and the specification table.

risks.risk: The bulbs may be non-functional or the box may contain a different model than the sticker indicates.
risks.proof: Video of the box being opened and the bulbs being tested on a 12V power source.
